h1: Kitchen remodeling that fits the way you live
intro: The kitchen is the heart of the home, and Yoerger Renovations is here to help you create a space that is both beautiful and functional. Whether you want a complete kitchen transformation or a simple update, Ryan works with you to design a kitchen that fits your lifestyle, your needs and your budget.

From cabinets and countertops to flooring, backsplashes, lighting and layout improvements, every project gets the same quality craftsmanship and attention to detail. The goal is a kitchen you'll love for years to come, one that adds real value to your home.

faqs.q: Do I have to gut the whole kitchen?
faqs.a: No. Plenty of kitchens just need new counters, a backsplash, paint and hardware to feel new again. Ryan will tell you honestly what will make the biggest difference for your budget.

faqs.q: How long will my kitchen be out of commission?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope. Your written quote includes a realistic timeline, and Ryan keeps you posted if anything shifts. Small refreshes are often days; full remodels take longer.

faqs.q: Can you work from photos I've saved?
faqs.a: Yes. Bring your Pinterest board, screenshots or magazine pages to the walkthrough. That's usually the fastest way to nail down the look you're after.

faqs.q: Do you charge for the estimate?
faqs.a: No. The walkthrough and written quote are free, with no pressure to commit.

faqs.q: Can you turn my tub into a walk-in shower?

faqs.q: Will I be without a bathroom the whole time?

h1: Basement finishing that turns storage into living space
intro: Turn your unfinished or outdated basement into a valuable extension of your home. Yoerger Renovations specializes in creating comfortable, functional spaces that fit your family's needs and lifestyle.

Family room, home office, playroom, guest suite, entertainment area or home gym: Ryan can help bring the idea to life. From framing and drywall to flooring, lighting, trim work and custom features, he handles every part of the finish with professionalism and care, using durable materials so it's built to last.

faqs.q: My basement is a blank concrete box. Where do we start?
faqs.a: With a walkthrough. Ryan looks at the layout, moisture, ceiling height and mechanicals, then sketches options with you before anything gets priced.

faqs.q: Can you add a bathroom or a bar?
faqs.a: Yes. Both are common parts of a basement finish, and they're easiest to plan from the start.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to finish a basement?
faqs.a: Often, yes, depending on your city and the scope. Ryan tells you up front what your municipality requires and how it's handled.

faqs.q: How do you handle the ceiling?
faqs.a: Drywall, drop ceiling, or a tongue-and-groove pine ceiling like the walkout basement in our photos. Each has trade-offs for access and look, and Ryan will walk you through them.

h1: Custom decks built for Ohio weather
intro: Extend your living space outdoors with a custom-built deck designed for relaxing, entertaining and making memories with family and friends. Yoerger Renovations builds high-quality wood and composite decks tailored to your home's style, your budget and how you plan to use the space.

Whether you want a simple backyard deck, a multi-level design, built-in seating, custom railings or low-maintenance composite materials, the focus is on quality craftsmanship and attention to detail from start to finish. Every deck is built to be safe, durable and beautiful for years to come, ready for cookouts, gatherings and enjoying Northeast Ohio's seasons.

faqs.q: Composite or pressure-treated wood?
faqs.a: Composite costs more up front and needs almost no maintenance. Pressure-treated wood costs less and looks great, but wants a stain or seal every few years. Ryan will price both so you can decide.

faqs.q: Can you rebuild on my existing deck frame?
faqs.a: Sometimes. If the framing and posts are sound, a re-deck with new boards and railings saves money. If they're not, Ryan will show you why and quote a proper rebuild.

faqs.q: Do decks need a permit?
faqs.a: In Stow and most Summit and Portage County cities, yes. Ryan tells you what your city requires and handles the details so the deck is built to code.

faqs.q: When is the best time to build?
faqs.a: Spring through fall is the busy season, so getting on the schedule early helps. Some builds can happen in cooler months too.

highlights: Light fixture, faucet and vanity swaps
Punch lists before a sale or after an inspection

faqs.q: How small is too small?
faqs.a: There's no such thing. A single door or a shelf is fine. If you have several small things, put them all on the list; one visit usually covers more than you'd expect.

faqs.q: Can you bundle a bunch of little jobs into one visit?
faqs.a: Yes, and it's the best way to do it. Ryan looks at the list, gives you one written quote for the whole thing, and knocks it out in a planned block of time.

faqs.q: Do you handle plumbing and electrical?
faqs.a: Fixture swaps like faucets, vanities and light fixtures, yes. Anything that needs a licensed trade, Ryan will tell you up front and can help coordinate.

faqs.q: Do you do pre-sale and inspection repair lists?
faqs.a: Yes. Inspection repair lists and move-out fixes are common requests. Send the report or the list and Ryan will quote it.
